title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: So Dave Baldwin has been portrayed to me as a really bad dude
Not sure about bad but he’s pretty ruthless and frankly just crazy young for that huge of a job
As a result all new hires are real young now
I’ve heard borderline sexual harassment/discrimination stuff about Baldwin
I mean, keep this between me and you, but people are very willing to speak about this
Yea off record though of course. Our HR isn’t even in the park anymore. They have everything at LCA now. We can’t even get supplies anymore. They abandoned the whole park as if it’s a step child
